text:
Hi,

I’m a hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience and a strong passion for research, organization, and building practical AI-powered workflows that save time and improve quality. I’d be glad to support your conversion agency as a virtual assistant and help with web research, lead generation, Google Sheets management, email drafting, and project coordination.

I have experience working with Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, and machine learning tools, and I’m comfortable handling structured information carefully and consistently. For example, I built a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. The assistant answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. In that project, clause lookup went from 25 minutes to 3 minutes, and the system reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set. That experience strengthened my attention to detail, my ability to organize information, and my habit of working accurately under clear guidelines.

For your role, I can help with thorough web research, identify and organize leads, keep Google Sheets clean and up to date, and draft clear, professional emails to potential candidates. I also understand the importance of communication, consistency, and follow-through when supporting a fast-moving team. While I have not worked directly inside a CRO agency, I’m very comfortable adapting quickly to new processes and contributing in a reliable, organized way.

I’m especially interested in your test task and am willing to complete it. I see that as a good opportunity to demonstrate my approach, responsiveness, and quality of work before moving forward. I’m also comfortable with project management tools like Asana and can integrate smoothly into your workflow.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and ready to contribute quickly, I’d be happy to discuss how I can support your team. Thank you for your consideration, and I look forward to hearing from you.
